# Heartbeat

> A calm command center for your accounts — calendars, tasks, notes and meetings in one place.

Heartbeat helps founders and operators run multiple businesses from a single, focused workspace. It brings together a daily plan, a weekly review, tasks, notes, meeting summaries, and a shared calendar so teams can move with purpose without context-switching across tools.
